search_text: published ZDI-06-015 ZDI-CAN-033 Apple QuickTime H.264 Parsing Buffer Overflow Vulnerability 2006-05-11 CVE-2006-1463 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2006-1463 ['Apple'] ['Quicktime'] This vulnerability allows attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Apple's QuickTime media player. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of H.264 content. The implicit trust of a user-supplied size value during a memory copy loop allows an attacker to create an exploitable memory corruption condition. Exploitation requires that an attacker either coerce the target to open a malformed media file or visit a website embedding the malicious file.
